package.description: Lightweight and modern desktop file shelf and workspace organizer for Windows.

en-US.description: Lightweight and modern desktop file shelf and workspace organizer for Windows.
en-US.longDescription:
KyteShelf is an elegant, multi-workspace desktop shelf for Windows.
It acts as a temporary holding zone and staging area for frequently accessed files, quick drag-and-drop actions, sticky notes, and tags.
en-US.name: KyteShelf
en-US.releaseNotes:
[修復與穩定性] 修復從網頁瀏覽器拖曳圖片時因 OLE 虛擬檔案誤判與剪貼簿衝突導致當掉的問題
[非同步載入] 網頁遠端圖片全面採用背景非同步執行緒下載，UI 主執行緒零卡頓零凍結
[圖片支援] 支援 Base64 Data URL 圖片解析解碼入架，支援多種圖片二進位點陣圖格式",
[Fix & Stability] Fixed freeze/crash when dragging images from web browsers due to OLE descriptor collision and clipboard lock
[Async Download] Asynchronous background downloading for remote web images, completely non-blocking UI
[Image Support] Added Base64 Data URL decoding support and native binary image drop handling",
